name: codea-monorepo
description: Codea — the coding assistant by Alia: a VS Code extension and a terminal CLI

scripts.build: bun run --filter alia-codea build && bun run --filter @alia-codea/cli build
scripts.typecheck: bun run --filter alia-codea typecheck && bun run --filter @alia-codea/cli typecheck && bunx tsc -b packages/vscode/webview-ui
scripts.test: bun run --filter alia-codea test && bun run --filter @alia-codea/cli test
